prompts.name: aluminium
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Minecraft item texture. The input is the original Minecraft iron-ingot sprite, enlarged with nearest-neighbor. EDIT this into a different material while preserving its EXACT classic Minecraft ingot silhouette, diagonal orientation, proportions, flat broad top, short front face, right face and 16x16 pixel grid. The outline must match the input, with the same stepped pixel boundaries. This is a palette-and-shading edit, not a new 3D object. Clean simple vanilla Minecraft pixel art, maximum 7 flat colors, one uniform color per square pixel. Crisp hard edges, genuine transparent background and transparent padding same as reference. No gradients, glow, antialiasing, smoothing, noise, small pixel details, scratches, dents, rust, cracks, stains, random speckles, logos, letters or text. No tall or wedge-shaped prism. Strong simple edge contrast and clear planar shading, legible at 16x16. Output a square enlarged pixel sprite like the reference. Material: ALUMINIUM. Very light clean cool silver ingot, pearl-white broad top plane, a restrained icy blue-silver right face, medium-light silver front face, clean white bevel highlight at upper left, medium cool blue-gray outline. The top stays very bright. Subtle blue hint makes it distinct from ordinary iron, but absolutely metallic SILVER, not cyan, diamond or glass. Smooth clean lightweight metal. This must read as the bright silver member of a two-metal set.
